# Checkout

Progress through checkout before an order exists.

[All domains](README.md)

## `checkout_completed`

Checkout finished and an order is being placed.

**Sources:** browser, server · **Version:** 1

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `commerce.cartId` | string | yes |  |

Other fields come from the `commerce` block.

```json
{
  "commerce": {
    "cartId": "c1",
    "orderId": "o1"
  }
}
```
